---
title: "Get Halpern Human Impact Index"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Mean cumulative human impact index for each study area, from the current
layer of the SSP2-4.5 scenario in Halpern et al. (2025), "Cumulative
impacts to global marine ecosystems projected to more than double by
mid-century": <https://knb.ecoinformatics.org/view/doi%3A10.5063%2FF18K77KZ>.
The layer is `Data/ssp245_current.tif` (17 MB).

Reads and updates `Data/network_info.rds` (adds `impact_mean`).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
required_packages <- c("sf", "terra", "exactextractr", "tidyverse")
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r impact}
# Bounding boxes of the study areas
regions <- tibble::tibble(
  name = c("San Jorge Gulf", "Beagle Channel", "Burdwood Bank", "North Scotia Sea", "South Scotia Sea", "Potter Cove", "Weddell Sea"),
  lon_min = c(-67.7, -68.58, -62, -45 , -53,  -58.73, -35),
  lon_max = c(-65.5, -68.19, -56, -38 , -46 , -58.62, -25),
  lat_min = c(-47. , -54.89, -55, -55 , -62 , -62.21, -78),
  lat_max = c(-45. , -54.79, -53, -48 , -55 , -62.25, -74)
)

region_sf <- regions %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(geometry = list(st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(lon_min, lat_min,
      lon_max, lat_min,
      lon_max, lat_max,
      lon_min, lat_max,
      lon_min, lat_min),
    ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))))) %>%
  st_as_sf(crs = 4326)

r <- rast("Data/ssp245_current.tif")
region_sf_r <- st_transform(region_sf, crs(r))

impact_stats <- exact_extract(
  r,
  region_sf_r,
  function(values, coverage_fraction) {
    v <- values[!is.na(values)]
    tibble(
      impact_mean = mean(v),
      sd   = sd(v),
      cv   = sd / impact_mean,
      n    = length(v)
    )
  }
)

region_sf <- bind_cols(region_sf, impact_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    lat_mid = (lat_min + lat_max) / 2,
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_low  = impact_mean - 1.96 * se,
    ci_high = impact_mean + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  arrange(lat_mid) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = name))

ggplot(region_sf, aes(x = name, y = impact_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.15) +
  labs(x = "Region (ordered by latitude)", y = "Mean Human Impact Index") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r saveImpact, eval = FALSE}
# eval = FALSE: overwrites Data/network_info.rds; run by hand.
impact_tbl <- region_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(name = as.character(name)) %>%
  dplyr::select(name, impact_mean)

network_info <- readRDS("Data/network_info.rds") %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("impact_mean", "impact_mean2015"))) %>%
  left_join(impact_tbl, by = "name")

stopifnot(!anyNA(network_info$impact_mean))
saveRDS(network_info, "Data/network_info.rds")
```
